facts.fact: 他跟到了 22 号，坐在唱机旁摇椅子——George-Finlay-Mun-fucking-ro。
facts.anchor: Rocking back and forth on his chair, clunking the legs off the floor with every swing, is George-Finlay-Mun-fucking-ro.

facts.fact: 她的底牌早被翻走：藏在柜中盒里的 22 号钥匙——被他发现。
facts.anchor: didn’t hide her flat keys very well. I found them stashed in a box inside the cupboard

facts.fact: 「配钥匙买一送一」——他手里也有 22 号的钥匙。
facts.anchor: Got a great two for one on key cutting if you’re ever looking.

facts.fact: 车钥匙的回旋镖：Blair 逃走时顺走的车被拿回——今天他开车来的。
facts.anchor: ‘Thanks for bringing back my car. It was good of you to return what’s mine.

facts.fact: 他预演好的剧本：疯女人杀了他女友、他「只好正当防卫」。
facts.anchor: Some crazy bitch broke into my flat and tried to murder me and my girlfriend.

facts.fact: 他的动机自白：梦生活=他+她+妈妈——「是你毁了一切，你逼我这么做」。
facts.anchor: ‘We were so good together, Blair. We could have lived the dream life. The good life. Just the two of us. And Mum, of course.

facts.fact: 换人逻辑：Cassie「更合适」——他闻得见她身上的绝望味。
facts.anchor: She was the better fit. You were too chaotic to ever compare.

facts.fact: 终局：Cassie 抡起那块玫瑰石英砸进他的头颅——像砸开红丝绒复活节彩蛋。
facts.anchor: plunges it into George’s head, cracking it open like a red velvet Easter egg.
